Container.Name: serversend
Container.Overview: ServerSend private file backup server (experimental). Runs as UID/GID 10001: chown the four host paths to 10001:10001 and chmod 700 before first start. Keep config on a pool, never SMB/NFS. Stop the container before running maintenance commands.
Container.Changes: Template 1: ports, paths, certificate IPs and automatic pre-upgrade backups.

Config.Name: HTTPS
Config.Description: HTTPS and HTTP/2 fallback. Keep host and container ports equal.

Config.Name: HTTP/3
Config.Description: HTTP/3 over QUIC. If blocked, clients use HTTP/2 over TCP.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Database, identity, keys and certificates. Pool-backed local storage only.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Uploaded files. Stop the container while the mover runs on this share.

Config.Name: Staging
Config.Description: Temporary files and SQLite spill space.

Config.Name: Backups
Config.Description: Automatic pre-upgrade backups. Needs space for a full copy of config, data and staging. Use a different share from the three paths above.

Config.Name: Certificate IPs
Config.Description: Comma-separated IPv4 addresses clients use, e.g. the Unraid LAN IP and Tailscale IP.

Config.Name: Upgrade backup directory
Config.Description: Where schema upgrades first write a backup. Set to none only if you take your own stopped-server backups.
